:::{.bio}
Hi! I'm a sixth year PhD student in the [Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences](https://copsy.brown.edu/) at [Brown University](https://www.brown.edu/). I'm advised by [Roman Feiman](https://www.brown.edu/academics/cognitive-linguistic-psychological-sciences/people/faculty/roman-feiman) and affiliated with the [BLT lab](https://sites.brown.edu/bltlab/). Here is the most updated version my [CV](cv.pdf). 

About my name: To pronounce my last name semi-accurately (i.e. enough to make me realize that I am being referred to), you could say *juice* without the [s]. For the phonetics enthusiasts, here is my full name in [IPA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Phonetic_Alphabet): [jɛnwan ʈʂu]

:::
